$comment: Known environment failures: per platform (process.platform) and backend, the scenario keys that differ for a reason outside the runtime. run.mjs check reports such a scenario as KNOWN and does not count it as failed only when exactly these keys differ; any other difference fails. Every entry names its reason.

05-input.reason: Meta+A is not select-all on Linux (WebKit and Chromium use Ctrl+A there), so the field keeps its text and fires change on blur; the goldens are macOS behavior.

18-print.reason: Linux font metrics render the printed text image 1 px taller (400x38 instead of 400x37).
